review_scope: Individually localized all 277 entries, 10 titles, FAQ and long paragraphs from English. Verified rate orientation, 29 cm paper notebook, body versus garment measurement/flat width, option codes 04A/04B, warehouse/order/parcel identity and current cross-language erratum for the 12.00-to-13.00 example.

corrections.source: How do I look for an iTaoBuy listing when I only have a photo?
corrections.translation: 写真しかない商品をiTaoBuyで探すには？

corrections.source: Use the camera entry to open image search and crop the picture to one item. Examine several candidates. Compare seams, fasteners, labels and the original seller link before calling a result the same model.
corrections.translation: カメラのアイコンから画像検索を開き、一点だけを切り抜きます。複数候補で縫い目、留め具、ラベル、販売元リンクを比べてから同じモデルかを判断します。

corrections.source: Why might several sellers match the same reference photo?
corrections.translation: 同じ参考写真に複数の販売店が一致するのはなぜですか？

corrections.source: Sellers can use similar studio shots or show visually close products. Compare the marketplace identifier, seller and selected version. The nearest image match gives you a candidate to investigate.
corrections.translation: 同じようなスタジオ写真や外観の似た商品が使われることがあります。販売サイトの商品番号、店舗、選んだ仕様を比較します。一番似た画像は確認する候補と考えましょう。

corrections.source: What do I keep when a spreadsheet link opens on iTaoBuy?
corrections.translation: 商品表のリンクがiTaoBuyで開いたら、何を保存しますか？

corrections.source: Save the original marketplace URL, seller's item number, selected option wording and quantity. The agent page and marketplace page serve different purposes, so keep a copy of both.
corrections.translation: 元の販売ページのURL、販売店の商品番号、選んだ仕様の原文と数量を保存します。代行ページと販売ページは役割が違うため、両方の控えを残します。

corrections.source: How do I compare two translated style labels that look identical?
corrections.translation: 翻訳すると同じ名前になる二つの仕様は、どう見分けますか？

corrections.source: Read each original label and keep any suffix, model number or swatch position. Select each option in turn and note which image, price or size range changes. Ask for clarification before choosing if the distinction remains unclear.
corrections.translation: 選択肢の原文を読み、末尾の記号、型番、色見本の位置を残します。一つずつ選んで写真、価格、選べるサイズのどれが変わるかを記録します。違いが読めなければ注文前に尋ねます。

corrections.source: Can an item link preserve the colour I selected?
corrections.translation: 商品リンクには選択した色も保存されますか？

corrections.source: Test it by reopening the copied link and comparing the selection. If it returns to a default option, save the original option text and screenshot of the intended colour beside the link.
corrections.translation: コピーしたリンクを開き直し、選択状態を比べます。既定の仕様に戻るなら、リンクに色の選択肢の原文と希望色を選んだ画面の画像を添えます。

corrections.source: What should a manual note say for a two-tone colourway?
corrections.translation: ツートーンの商品を頼むとき、備考には何を書きますか？

corrections.source: Give both colours, their positions on the item and the seller's option text or code. For example, distinguish a black body with white sleeves from a white body with black sleeves.
corrections.translation: 二色の名前、それぞれの位置、販売店の選択肢の原文かコードを書きます。例えば「身頃が黒で袖が白」と「身頃が白で袖が黒」を区別します。

corrections.source: How do I tell whether a size chart gives flat width or circumference?
corrections.translation: サイズ表の数字が平置きの身幅か、一周の寸法かを見分けるには？

corrections.source: Look at the diagram and its endpoints. If the chart measures straight across a laid-flat garment, take the same flat measurement from one you own. Ask the seller when a heading gives only a number without a method.
corrections.translation: 図と測り始め・終わりの位置を見ます。平置きの服を横に測る表なら、手持ちの服も同じ方法で測ります。数字だけで測り方がない場合は販売店に確認します。

corrections.source: When should I use a garment measurement instead of a body measurement?
corrections.translation: 身体の寸法と服の実寸は、どちらを比較基準にしますか？

corrections.source: Follow the chart definition. Compare a garment chart with a similar garment measured the same way. A body-size chart describes the wearer and may already allow for ease, so it requires a different comparison.
corrections.translation: 表の定義に従います。衣服の寸法表には手持ちの似た服を同じ方法で測って比べます。身体のサイズ表は着用者についての表で、ゆとりを考慮済みの場合もあり、別の基準で読みます。

corrections.source: How do I verify what is included in a matching set?
corrections.translation: セットの販売単位には何が含まれるか、どう確認しますか？

corrections.source: Read the selected unit description, especially when separate pieces and complete sets share a listing. Keep the selection and subtotal together. The model's outfit in a promotional picture is insufficient evidence of quantity.
corrections.translation: 単品とセットが同じページにある場合は特に、選択した販売単位の説明を読みます。選択と小計を一緒に保管します。モデルが一式を着ているだけでは、届く数量の証拠になりません。

corrections.source: How can I separate QC photos for several nearly identical orders?
corrections.translation: よく似た注文がいくつかある場合、検品写真をどう整理しますか？

corrections.source: Use one folder or note per order line with the original option and warehouse reference. Keep at least one full view with the label close-up so the detail can be connected to that unit.
corrections.translation: 注文明細ごとにフォルダーかメモを作り、元の仕様と倉庫の管理番号を入れます。タグの接写には少なくとも一枚の全体写真を添え、どの商品かをたどれるようにします。

corrections.source: Can I use another buyer's QC measurement for my own order?
corrections.translation: 他の購入者の検品時の実測値を自分の注文にも使えますか？

corrections.source: Use it as a reference only when the listing, size and measurement method are identifiable. To decide about your received unit, use a picture or measurement tied to its warehouse entry.
corrections.translation: 出品、サイズ、測定方法が分かる場合に参考として使えます。自分が受け取った商品を判断するには、その倉庫明細に付いた写真か実測値を使います。

corrections.source: Why does a seller tracking number say delivered before I receive anything?
corrections.translation: まだ届いていないのに、販売店の追跡が配達済みなのはなぜですか？

corrections.source: Check the destination of that shipment. Domestic delivery to the warehouse and an international parcel sent to you have different endpoints. Find the outbound parcel reference before looking for the final delivery scan.
corrections.translation: その配送の宛先を確認します。販売店から中国の倉庫までの配送と、自宅までの国際配送は終点が違います。最終配達を追う前に倉庫からの出荷番号を探します。

corrections.source: How do I compare a CNY listing and a converted display price?
corrections.translation: 人民元（CNY）の出品価格と換算表示をどう比べますか？

corrections.source: Record the underlying seller amount, option and quantity. Note the exchange rate and time of comparison, then verify the currency and total at checkout. Payment conversion and a catalogue display may produce different totals.
corrections.translation: 販売店の元の金額、選択、数量を記録します。比較時刻とレートを控え、決済時に通貨と総額を確かめます。一覧の表示換算と決済時の換算は同額とは限りません。

corrections.source: What should I include when reporting a parcel problem?
corrections.translation: 荷物の問題を報告するときは何を添えますか？

corrections.source: List the outbound parcel number, affected purchase reference, last known scan and a short description of the missing or damaged contents. Keep pictures of the label and packing with that record.
corrections.translation: 出荷番号、該当商品の購入番号、最後に分かっている追跡履歴、不足・破損した中身を簡潔に示します。荷札と梱包状態の写真も一緒に保管します。

corrections.source: What can I do if a cropped image search finds the wrong item?
corrections.translation: 画像を切り抜いて検索しても違う商品が出るときは？

corrections.source: Try one crop that shows the outline and another that shows a distinctive construction detail. Remove unrelated garments and background logos. Open the best candidates and verify the option in the seller listing.
corrections.translation: 輪郭が分かる切り抜きと、構造上の特徴が分かる切り抜きを試します。無関係な服や背景のロゴを除き、有力な候補の販売ページで仕様を確認します。

corrections.source: Should I confirm a replacement from a thumbnail alone?
corrections.translation: 小さな商品画像だけで代替品を承認してよいですか？

corrections.source: Ask for the replacement's marketplace link and exact option text, then check the differences in material, size or quantity. Keep your approval associated with that version so your warehouse checks use the correct reference.
corrections.translation: 代替品の販売ページと選択肢の原文を求め、素材、サイズ、数量の違いを調べます。倉庫検品でも正しい対象を使えるよう、承認内容とその仕様を結び付けて保存します。

corrections.source: Where does iTaoBuy describe its ordering and QC service?
corrections.translation: iTaoBuyの注文代行・検品サービスの説明はどこにありますか？

corrections.source: The developer's app listing explains link-based purchasing, warehouse photos and international shipping choices. For a question about a particular purchase or parcel, use the corresponding record in your account and its current support options.
corrections.translation: 開発元によるアプリの掲載ページに、リンクからの買い付け、倉庫写真、国際配送の選択肢が説明されています。個別の購入や荷物は、アカウント内の該当明細と現在利用できる問い合わせ窓口を確認します。

corrections.source: Before opening an iTaoBuy spreadsheet link: check the listing, option and handoff
corrections.translation: iTaoBuyの商品表から注文する前に、販売ページ・仕様・取り込み結果を確認する

corrections.source: A spreadsheet row can be a convenient way to find a product, yet it condenses several decisions into one link. Follow the handoff from the catalogue to the seller and the agent before approving the actual purchase.
corrections.translation: 商品表の一行は、商品を見つける手掛かりになる一方、販売先、仕様、購入条件など複数の判断を一つのリンクにまとめています。実際の購入を承認する前に、一覧から販売店、代行業者へと引き継がれる情報を確かめます。

corrections.source: iTaoBuy · Google Play
corrections.translation: iTaoBuy｜Google Play

corrections.source: iTaoBuy · App Store
corrections.translation: iTaoBuy｜App Store

corrections.source: Assign a job to each page
corrections.translation: 各ページで確認する内容を分ける

corrections.source: The spreadsheet is useful for discovery. The original marketplace page identifies what a particular seller is offering. The iTaoBuy purchase page records the selection you are preparing to submit through the agent. You might see the same title or photograph on all three, but this does not make them interchangeable. A catalogue price can be a starting price, an option on the seller page can be sold out and the import can default to another available choice. Review the final purchase record separately.
corrections.translation: 商品表は候補を探す場、元の販売ページは特定の店の販売内容を確かめる場、iTaoBuyの購入画面は代行購入する仕様を選ぶ場です。同じ写真やタイトルでも役割は異なります。一覧には最低価格が出ていても、欲しい仕様は品切れかもしれず、取り込み時に別の仕様が初期選択されることもあります。最終的な注文明細を別途確認します。

corrections.source: Suppose a row shows a dark overshirt with two chest pockets. You want that exact style in medium. The row tells you enough to open a candidate. It cannot, by itself, establish that the seller still offers the same construction in medium at the displayed amount. Write down the listing feature that made the row worth opening. Doing this at the start helps prevent a visually similar substitute from becoming your choice simply because it was the easiest option available on the next page.
corrections.translation: 胸ポケット二つの濃色シャツジャケットを見つけ、その型のMが欲しいとします。一覧の一行は候補を開くには十分でも、その店が今も同じ構造のMを表示額で売っているとは確認できません。最初に選ぶ決め手を控えると、次のページで選びやすかっただけの似た商品に乗り換えるのを防げます。

corrections.source: Check the destination before entering account information
corrections.translation: アカウント情報を入力する前にリンク先を確認する

corrections.source: Look at the address of the actual page that opens. A button label can describe its intended destination, but the browser address tells you where you are. If you expected an agent purchase page and land on a different merchant, link-shortening service or an unexpected sign-in form, pause and identify why. A link opening a seller page for reference serves a different purpose from a link taking you to an agent checkout. Make sure the destination matches the action you intend to take.
corrections.translation: 押したボタンの名前ではなく、開いたブラウザーのアドレスを見ます。代行購入の画面のつもりが別の店、短縮リンク、予期しないログイン画面に着いたら、入力前に理由を確かめます。参考用に販売ページを開くリンクと、代行の決済に進むリンクでは目的が違います。行いたい操作と実際の行き先を照合します。

corrections.source: For a saved marketplace listing, keep its original address and item identifier. If the agent link stops importing correctly, the developer's iTaoBuy app listing describes pasting marketplace links to start a purchase. Use the item reference to compare what the import returns. Avoid carrying unrelated tracking parameters into your notes when a clear marketplace item identifier is already available. At the same time, retain any genuinely necessary option information separately, since a product identifier often identifies a whole listing containing multiple styles.
corrections.translation: 元の販売ページのアドレスと商品番号を保存します。代行リンクの取り込みがうまくいかない場合、開発元によるiTaoBuyのアプリ説明には販売リンクを貼って購入を始める方法があります。取り込まれた内容を商品番号で照合します。不要な追跡用パラメーターを控える必要はありませんが、商品番号は複数仕様をまとめた出品全体を示す場合があるため、必要な選択情報は別に保存します。

corrections.source: Match the seller listing at more than one point
corrections.translation: 複数の手掛かりで販売ページを照合する

corrections.source: Compare the seller or shop name where visible, the marketplace item number and the option selector. Product titles are weak identifiers because translations can vary and sellers can reuse similar wording. Images can be shared across multiple offers. An identifier on a particular marketplace is stronger evidence of listing identity, but even a confirmed listing can change its contents over time. Check that the intended option still exists on the current page rather than relying exclusively on an old screenshot.
corrections.translation: 見える範囲で販売店名、商品番号、選択欄を比べます。商品名は翻訳が揺れ、似た名前を使う店も多く、写真も別の出品と共通の場合があります。同じ販売サイトで商品番号が合えば有力な手掛かりですが、ページの内容は後で変わり得ます。古い画面だけで判断せず、希望の仕様が現在の選択肢にあるかを見ます。

corrections.source: In the overshirt example, count the pockets and inspect the arrangement of the buttons. Then locate the dark option and see whether medium is available for that option. If neutral and dark versions have different constructions, select each to determine which specifications apply. A screenshot showing the dark cover photograph and a separate dropdown listing medium does not prove that dark medium is a valid combination. Try selecting the combination and read what the page actually displays for it.
corrections.translation: シャツジャケットならポケットの数とボタンの並びを見てから、濃色を選んだ状態でMが選べるか試します。淡い中間色と濃色で作りが違えば、それぞれを選んで説明を確認します。濃色の代表写真とMという項目が別々に写っていても、濃色Mが選べる証明にはなりません。実際の組み合わせを選び、その状態の表示を読みます。

corrections.source: Read the unit, quantity and price after selection
corrections.translation: 選択後に販売単位・数量・価格を読む

corrections.source: Ask what one unit buys. A listing for a shirt might include a separate accessory sold at a lower price. A set may offer the top, trousers and complete outfit under one title. A displayed range can include all of these options. Select the exact combination first and record the resulting unit price. Then set quantity and check the subtotal. Compare the seller's order unit with the quantity shown on iTaoBuy after import. A quantity of two might mean two garments or two sets.
corrections.translation: 数量一で何が届くかを読みます。シャツと安い付属品、あるいは上着、パンツ、上下セットを同じ出品で売る場合、価格帯はそれらすべてを含みます。希望仕様を先に選んで単価を控え、次に数量を設定して小計を見ます。元の販売単位とiTaoBuyへ取り込んだ数量の意味を比較します。二という数は服二点のこともセット二組のこともあります。

corrections.source: Use a simple hypothetical example. A row starts at 38 yuan, a listing offers a separate belt at 38 and the overshirt at 118. Choosing two overshirts gives a merchandise subtotal of 236 yuan before other applicable charges. If you compare that with twice the headline number, the difference is an option difference, not necessarily a price error. Write the original currency alongside the amount. If the checkout also displays a conversion, retain the unconverted subtotal for comparison when the display currency changes.
corrections.translation: 架空の例で、一覧に「38元から」とあっても、販売ページでは別売りのベルトが38元、シャツジャケットが118元かもしれません。シャツジャケットを二着選べば、他の費用を除く商品小計は236元です。代表価格の二倍と違うのは選んだ商品の差で、必ずしも価格の誤りではありません。金額と元の通貨を併記し、決済画面に換算額も出る場合は、表示通貨が変わっても比べられるよう換算前の小計を残します。

corrections.source: Inspect what survives when the page is reopened
corrections.translation: リンクを開き直しても選択が残るか試す

corrections.source: A saved link can reopen at the top of a product rather than the particular selection you had highlighted. Test this before sharing the link with a friend or handing it to another person preparing the order. Open the saved address in another tab, note the default selection and compare it with your record. If the choice resets, send the item link together with the original option text, colour and size. Add a screenshot showing the selector in context if the wording is ambiguous.
corrections.translation: 保存したリンクは、選んでいた仕様でなく商品ページの先頭を開くことがあります。他の人に渡す前に、別タブで開き直し既定の選択を控えと比較します。初期化されるなら商品リンクに選択肢の原文、色、サイズを添えます。文言が曖昧なら、選択欄とその周囲が分かる画面も付けます。

corrections.source: This matters even when the seller item number matches perfectly. Consider two versions described as dark blue and blue-black by one translation but both shown as navy by another. Record the original wording and the feature that distinguishes them, such as buttons, wash or pocket shape. A message that identifies the marketplace listing and intended selection gives the agent something actionable to check. A message containing only a photograph requires someone else to guess which option the seller meant.
corrections.translation: 販売店の商品番号が完全に一致していても同じです。「濃紺」「青黒」と訳し分ける翻訳もあれば、両方を「ネイビー」とする場合もあります。ボタン、洗い加工、ポケットの形など区別できる特徴と原文を残します。販売ページと希望仕様を組で伝えれば確認できますが、写真だけではどの選択肢かを他の人が推測することになります。

corrections.source: Resolve the first disagreement before proceeding
corrections.translation: 最初に食い違った箇所を解決してから進む

corrections.source: When catalogue, seller and agent disagree, identify the first step at which the information changes. If the seller page no longer contains medium, the original row may be stale. If medium exists on the seller page but the agent import omits it, the question concerns the import or manual ordering route. If both list medium but the checkout subtotal changes after quantity is set, investigate unit pricing or domestic shipping. Different disagreements call for different evidence and different questions.
corrections.translation: 一覧、販売ページ、代行画面のどこで初めて変わったかを調べます。販売店にMがなければ一覧が古いかもしれません。店にはあるのに取り込み後にないなら、取り込みか手入力注文の相談です。両方にMがあるのに数量変更後の小計が違えば、単価や国内送料を見ます。変わった箇所で必要な証拠も質問も変わります。

corrections.source: Send the smallest useful packet: original marketplace URL, item identifier, the option text you selected and one screenshot of the mismatch. Describe the outcome you want. For example, ask whether the dark-medium overshirt can be obtained at the selected unit price before purchase. Avoid authorizing a substitute merely by asking about availability. If you would accept another colour, specify which colour and any price limit in a separate instruction after you have seen the alternative listing.
corrections.translation: 元の販売URL、商品番号、選んだ仕様の原文、相違が分かる画面一枚を送り、確認したい結果を示します。例えば「購入前に、濃色Mのシャツジャケットを選択時の単価で買えるか確認してください」と頼みます。在庫照会だけで代替品の購入を承認しないようにします。別色も許容するならその販売ページを見てから、色と価格上限を別に指定します。

corrections.source: Preserve a purchase record that can guide later QC
corrections.translation: 後の検品に使える購入記録を保存する

corrections.source: Once you choose to proceed, keep the row as a discovery reference and the final order as the authoritative record of your selection. Save the option, quantity, currency, amount and item reference from the purchase confirmation. When warehouse photographs become available, compare the received unit with this record. Start with the feature that originally mattered, then check label and quantity. Historical catalogue pictures can still help with comparison, but they do not replace photographs tied to your current purchase.
corrections.translation: 購入を決めたら一覧は発見の参考として残し、実際の選択は最終注文で確認します。購入確認から仕様、数量、通貨、金額、商品番号を保存します。入庫後はこの記録を基に、最初に重視した特徴、次にタグと数量を照合します。昔の一覧写真は比較の参考になりますが、今回の購入に付いた倉庫写真の代わりにはなりません。

corrections.source: A good handoff ends with one concise statement: which seller listing you opened, which exact option you chose and which evidence remains to be checked after receipt. It can also end with a deliberate decision to leave a listing alone because the option or destination remains unclear. Either outcome is preferable to treating an attractive spreadsheet row as proof of current price, stock and identity all at once. The point of checking the link is to establish a purchase decision that another person can reproduce.
corrections.translation: どの販売ページで、どの選択肢を選び、受け取り後に何を確認するかを一文にまとめます。行き先か仕様が不明で購入を見送るのも一つの結論です。一覧の魅力的な一行から価格、在庫、商品の一致を同時に断定せず、別の人が同じ判断を再現できる記録を残します。

corrections.source: Check links again when returning to a saved spreadsheet weeks later. A marketplace listing can keep the same address after a seller changes the available options or removes the cheapest variant. Open your saved option record beside the current seller page. If the product code matches but the selected size has disappeared, the link still identifies a relevant listing while failing to provide a purchasable version of your original choice.
corrections.translation: 数週間後に保存した商品表を使うときは再確認します。販売店が最安の仕様を外したり選択肢を更新したりしても、URLは同じままの場合があります。保存した選択記録と今のページを並べます。商品番号が合っていても希望サイズが消えていれば、関連ページには着けても元の仕様で購入できるとは限りません。

corrections.source: Does an iTaoBuy set include both pieces? Check the order unit before purchase
corrections.translation: iTaoBuyの上下セットは二点とも届く？ 購入前に販売単位を見分ける

corrections.source: A listing can show a full outfit while selling the jacket, trousers and complete set under different options. Verify the selected unit, then preserve enough information to count what reaches the warehouse.
corrections.translation: モデルが上下を着ていても、上着、パンツ、上下セットを別々の選択肢で売っている場合があります。何を一組として注文したかを確かめ、倉庫で届いた点数を照合できる記録を残します。

corrections.source: Read the listing as a set of offers
corrections.translation: 一つの出品にある複数の販売条件を読む

corrections.source: A hero photograph tells a visual story. A model may wear a jacket, trousers, belt and cap to show how they look together. The photograph alone says nothing definitive about which pieces the selected price buys. Open the seller options through the marketplace link and inspect the individual offers. Some listings use one selector for colour and another for product type. Others combine model, colour, size and unit into a single long string. Find the wording that identifies exactly what one ordered unit contains.
corrections.translation: モデルがジャケット、パンツ、ベルト、帽子を合わせていても、選んだ価格でそのすべてが届くとは限りません。元の販売リンクから個別の選択欄を開きます。色と商品種別を分けて選ぶ店も、型・色・サイズ・単位を一つの長い名前にまとめる店もあります。注文数量一で届く内容を特定する文言を探します。

corrections.source: Imagine a dark tracksuit shown with a matching top and bottom. The first seller option is jacket only, the second trousers only and the third set. The catalogue card may display the first available price, which in this example could belong to the trousers. If you want the complete outfit, select the set and check both the resulting dollar or yuan amount and the available sizes. A larger price after switching selections can reflect a different number of pieces rather than a pricing discrepancy.
corrections.translation: 濃色のジャージ上下を写したページで、選択肢がジャケットのみ、パンツのみ、上下セットの三つなら、一覧価格は最初に利用できるパンツ単品の額かもしれません。上下が必要ならセットを選び、その状態でのドルまたは元の価格とサイズを見ます。高くなった理由は価格の矛盾ではなく構成点数の違いかもしれません。

corrections.source: Separate component count from order quantity
corrections.translation: セットの構成点数と注文数量を区別する

corrections.source: Write two columns in your notes: units ordered and pieces per unit. One set containing a jacket and trousers is one order unit but two physical garments. Two such sets are two units and four garments. If the seller instead sells the jacket and trousers separately, one jacket plus one pair of trousers might appear as two order lines while yielding the same two garments. This distinction prevents both under-ordering and double counting when you review a later receipt.
corrections.translation: 「注文した単位数」と「一単位の構成点数」を分けます。ジャケットとパンツのセット一組は注文数量一、現物は二点です。二組なら注文数量二、現物は四点です。別売りの上着一点とパンツ一点を買えば注文二行で同じ二点が届きます。受領時の不足や二重計上を防げます。

corrections.source: Work through a hypothetical basket. A jacket costs 80 yuan, trousers 60 and the complete set 130. Ordering one jacket and one pair of trousers costs 140 before other charges, while selecting one complete set costs 130. Entering quantity two on the complete set would cost 260 and produce four garments if the offer is fulfilled as described. These invented values illustrate the method. Always read the actual seller unit, selected price and domestic charges before making the same comparison on a real listing.
corrections.translation: 例えばジャケット80元、パンツ60元、上下セット130元なら、単品を一つずつ買うと諸費用前で140元、セット一組なら130元です。セットの数量を二にすると260元で、説明どおりなら届く服は計四点です。これらは計算方法を示す仮の金額です。実際の出品では販売単位、選んだ後の価格、中国国内送料を確認して比べます。

corrections.source: Check whether top and bottom sizes can differ
corrections.translation: 上下で別サイズを選べるか確認する

corrections.source: A buyer might need a medium jacket and large trousers. Look at whether the complete-set selector allows independent sizes for each piece. A single size for the set may mean both pieces use that size, while separate individual options may give you more control. Do not assume a free-text note will override a fixed bundle. Ask whether the seller can supply your requested size mix and at what price before treating the mixed set as an available offer.
corrections.translation: 上着MとパンツLが欲しい場合、セットの選択欄で上下別サイズを指定できるか確認します。セットに一つだけサイズがあれば上下共通かもしれず、単品の方が細かく選べます。固定セットを備考だけで変えられると考えず、希望の組み合わせと価格を販売店に確認してから購入候補にします。

corrections.source: If the seller allows the mix, save the reply with the exact jacket and trouser sizes named. If the seller requires separate purchases, check both item identifiers and the resulting subtotal. If one piece is unavailable, decide whether the remaining item is acceptable on its own. An order note can state that you want to be contacted before buying an incomplete set. That instruction is more precise than asking the agent to “send whatever is available” when your original intent was to wear matching pieces together.
corrections.translation: 組み合わせが可能なら、上着とパンツの具体的なサイズ入りの回答を保存します。別々に買う必要があれば両方の商品番号と小計を確認します。一方がなければ残りだけでもよいか決め、必要なら「セットがそろわなければ買う前に連絡」と書きます。上下を合わせて着たいのに「あるものを送って」では意図が伝わりません。

corrections.source: Distinguish styling props from included accessories
corrections.translation: 撮影用の小物と付属品を見分ける

corrections.source: A cap, belt, detachable strap or small pouch can be included with one version and used as a styling prop in another. Look for a contents description, package list or seller message connected to the selected option. Compare the close photographs and see whether an accessory appears in multiple colours or only in a styled scene. Appearance in many pictures still does not establish inclusion if the purchase description says otherwise. Ask about the named piece directly where it affects your decision.
corrections.translation: 帽子、ベルト、取り外せるストラップ、小さなポーチは、ある仕様では付属し、別の仕様では撮影用かもしれません。選んだ仕様の内容説明、梱包一覧、販売店の回答を探します。接写や色別写真でも見えるか、コーディネート写真だけかを見ます。多くの写真に登場しても購入説明と違えば付属とは限らないため、必要な物を名指しで尋ねます。

corrections.source: Use location and function to identify ambiguous accessories. For a bag, “small removable pouch attached to the inside ring” is clearer than “extra bag.” For a tracksuit, specify whether a waist belt is a separate accessory or a built-in drawstring. Save the seller's original wording before translating it for your own notes. If you receive an answer, preserve the question as well so that a short affirmative response is connected to the correct component and product option.
corrections.translation: 付属品は位置と用途で特定します。バッグなら「追加のバッグ」より「内側のリングに付いた取り外せる小ポーチ」が明確です。ジャージなら腰ベルトが別の付属品か、縫い込まれたひもかを区別します。自分用に訳す前に原文を保存し、短い「はい」がどの部品と選択肢への回答か分かるよう質問も残します。

corrections.source: Verify the offer again on the agent purchase page
corrections.translation: 代行業者の買い付け画面で構成を再確認する

corrections.source: The iTaoBuy developer's description explains that the service reads pasted marketplace links. When the product opens, check that the intended set option has carried across and that quantity still means sets. Imported labels may be shortened, translated differently or default to the first entry. Compare the seller item identifier, option text and image. If the imported page shows only a colour and size with no component information, review the original selector before authorizing the purchase.
corrections.translation: iTaoBuyの開発元は、販売ページのリンクを貼り付けて商品を取り込む仕組みを説明しています。開いた画面で希望のセットが引き継がれ、数量が組数を指すか確認します。名前の省略、異なる翻訳、先頭の選択肢への初期化が起こり得ます。商品番号、原文、画像を照合し、色とサイズだけで構成が見えなければ承認前に元の選択欄を読みます。

corrections.source: Create a compact expected-contents record at checkout. For example: one complete dark set; jacket medium and trousers large as confirmed; two garments total; no cap; selected option code and seller reference saved. Add the actual price and currency. This list gives the warehouse check a definite target. It also avoids confusing an agent-facing purchase confirmation that says “quantity one” with evidence that only a single physical garment should arrive.
corrections.translation: 決済時に「濃色上下セット一組、確認済みの上着M・パンツL、服計二点、帽子なし、選択コードと販売番号を保存」など予定内容を記録し、実際の価格と通貨を添えます。倉庫検品の基準となり、代行業者の購入確認の「数量一」を現物一着と取り違えずに済みます。

corrections.source: Count what arrives using both evidence and context
corrections.translation: 倉庫の記録と写真を照合して届いた数量を数える

corrections.source: Open the warehouse entry attached to the actual purchase and compare its photographs with your expected-contents list. A folded pair of trousers can be partly hidden beneath a jacket. A top-down photo of a sealed retail bag may show only the upper piece. An absent piece in a single photo is a reason to ask for a check, not proof it was never supplied. Request an overview showing both garments separately if quantity is important to your decision.
corrections.translation: 購入と紐付いた倉庫明細を開き、写真と予定内容を照合します。畳んだパンツが上着の下に隠れ、密封袋の真上からは上の一着しか見えない場合があります。一枚の写真に写らなければ確認する理由にはなりますが、未納の証拠ではありません。数量が判断に重要なら上下を分けて並べた全体写真を頼みます。

corrections.source: For several sets, request identification by order line or size combination. Four garments laid out together can establish overall count while leaving it unclear which jacket belongs with which trousers. If the seller ships pieces separately, retain each domestic tracking reference and check for an outstanding second package. Do not submit the first piece internationally simply because its warehouse entry is visible if you intend to inspect and ship the complete set together.
corrections.translation: 複数組なら注文明細かサイズの組み合わせ別に特定してもらいます。四着をまとめた写真は総数を示しても上下の対応は不明かもしれません。分割発送なら各国内追跡番号を残し、二個目を待っていないか調べます。一緒に検品・発送したいなら、一点だけ入庫表示が出ても先に国際発送を申請しません。

corrections.source: Resolve discrepancies before changing the packing
corrections.translation: 梱包を変更する前に内容の相違を解決する

corrections.source: If the warehouse confirms a missing piece, provide the seller option description, purchase confirmation and expected-contents record. Name the absent component and ask what information is available about split dispatch or seller fulfilment. If the complete set arrived but one size is wrong, identify exactly which piece and whether the other one matches the accepted mix. This distinction helps support ask for the appropriate remedy rather than returning an entire set before the seller confirms what it needs.
corrections.translation: 倉庫が不足を確認したら、販売店の選択説明、購入確認、予定内容一覧を提示します。何が足りないかを名指しし、分割発送か、販売店がどこまで発送したか尋ねます。上下とも届いて一方だけサイズが違うなら、該当する服ともう一方のサイズが合意どおりかを記します。必要な内容を販売店に聞く前にセット全部を返す事態を避けられます。

corrections.source: Before disposing of packaging or separating components, check any return or exchange requirements relevant to that order. If the seller offers a partial resolution, compare it with your actual need. A partial credit may still leave you with an unusable half-outfit, while a replacement piece from another batch may differ in shade. Record the accepted outcome and recheck the eventual contents. The final picture you want is a complete match between the selected offer, the quantity paid for and the pieces you can identify in the warehouse.
corrections.translation: 包装を捨てたり上下を分けたりする前に、その注文の返品・交換条件を調べます。一部返金されても半分だけでは着られない場合があり、別ロットの交換品は色味が違うかもしれません。提案を自分の用途と比較して合意を記録し、最後の内容を再確認します。選んだ販売構成、支払った数量、倉庫で識別できる現物が一致することを確かめます。

corrections.source: Some listings include a case as packaging while others sell it as a separate component. The distinction matters when a group splits a purchase. Two brushes inside one fitted case may reasonably be described as a two-piece brush set, even though three objects arrive. Ask what each person expects to take home, then match that expectation to the seller's itemized contents. If both people need separate cases, record that requirement before ordering, since seeing one case in a picture cannot establish that each brush gets its own.
corrections.translation: ケースが単なる包装の場合と別の構成品の場合があり、共同購入で分けるときに重要です。専用ケース一つにブラシ二本なら、届く物体は三つでもブラシ二本セットと呼べます。各自が持ち帰りたい物と販売店の構成を照合します。それぞれにケースが必要なら購入前に明記します。写真に一つ写っても各ブラシに一つずつ付くとは限りません。

corrections.source: iTaoBuy price comparison: convert a seller price without losing sight of checkout
corrections.translation: iTaoBuyの価格比較：元の販売価格を換算し、決済総額まで照合する

corrections.source: A price in yuan, a catalogue conversion and a card charge can all describe the same purchase at different stages. Put the figures on a common basis before deciding that a listing costs more or less than another.
corrections.translation: 元建ての販売価格、商品一覧の換算額、カードに確定した請求額は、同じ購入の別の段階を表すことがあります。どの出品が高いかを決める前に、比較の基準をそろえます。

corrections.source: Write down the item behind the number
corrections.translation: 表示価格の対象商品を書き出す

corrections.source: Before opening a calculator, identify the marketplace listing, the selected option and the unit being sold. A product page may show a low starting amount for an accessory beside a photograph of the complete item. Another listing may show the price of a pair or a bundle. Changing the currency cannot make these units comparable. Select the option you would actually purchase, set a realistic quantity and capture its subtotal with the original currency still visible.
corrections.translation: 電卓を使う前に、販売ページ、選んだ仕様、販売単位を特定します。完成品の写真の脇に安い付属品の最低価格が出る場合もあれば、一組やセットの価格が出る場合もあります。通貨を切り替えても違う単位は比べられません。実際に買う仕様と数量を選び、元の通貨と小計が見える状態を保存します。

corrections.source: Suppose a listing offers a single cover, a pair of covers and a cushion with an insert. You want two covers. If the initial number describes one cover, multiply the correct single-unit selection by two unless the seller offers a separate pair option. If the pair has an explicit price, compare that with the single-unit alternative. Keep the unit description as a column in the comparison. A note that says only “row A: 79, row B: 88” leaves the most important assumption completely hidden.
corrections.translation: カバー単品、カバー二枚組、中材付きクッションが同じ出品で、欲しいのはカバー二枚とします。最初の表示が一枚分なら、正しい単品価格を二倍にします。二枚組が別にあれば、その組の表示価格と単品二枚の価格を比較します。表に販売単位の欄を設けましょう。「行Aが79、行Bが88」というメモだけでは、最も大切な構成の違いが分かりません。

corrections.source: Choose a rate direction and keep the units visible
corrections.translation: 為替レートの向きと単位を明記する

corrections.source: An exchange rate can be written as yuan per unit of your currency or units of your currency per yuan. Those descriptions are reciprocals. Write the direction in plain words before calculating. For a purely illustrative rate of eight yuan per unit of another currency, an 80-yuan item equals ten units before additional charges. Divide by eight to convert yuan into that currency. Multiplying by eight instead produces a number with no meaningful relationship to the intended conversion.
corrections.translation: 為替レートには、手元の通貨一単位が何元かを示す表示と、一元が手元の通貨でいくらかを示す表示があります。二つは逆数です。計算前に向きを言葉で書きます。仮に現地通貨一単位が8元なら、80元の商品は諸費用前で10単位です。元から現地通貨に換算するときは8で割ります。8を掛けてもこの向きの換算にはなりません。

corrections.source: If your rate is written the other way round, such as 0.125 units per yuan in this imaginary example, multiply 80 by 0.125 to arrive at ten. Check the two methods on a convenient amount before trusting a spreadsheet column. A simple diagnostic is to convert the result back using the same rate. Ten times eight returns 80 yuan. Small differences from rounding are normal; a result that is several times larger than the starting value calls for a check of the formula and units.
corrections.translation: 逆向きに「一元につき現地通貨0.125単位」と示す場合は、80に0.125を掛けて10単位になります。表計算の列を使う前に、分かりやすい金額で両方の式を試します。同じレートで戻せば10×8で80元です。丸めによるわずかな差は生じ得ますが、元の額の何倍にもなるなら式の向きと単位を確認します。

corrections.source: Separate the item subtotal from seller-to-warehouse delivery
corrections.translation: 商品小計と販売店から倉庫への送料を分ける

corrections.source: Now consider a fictional seller offering two covers at 42 yuan each and charging six yuan to send the combined purchase to the warehouse. The item subtotal is 84 yuan; the domestic purchase total is 90 yuan. At the made-up rate of eight yuan per currency unit, those are 10.50 and 11.25 respectively. Both converted numbers can be correct, but they describe different scopes. Label the first “goods” and the second “goods plus domestic delivery” in your notes.
corrections.translation: 架空の販売店でカバー二枚が一枚42元、まとめて倉庫へ送る国内送料が6元とします。商品小計は84元、送料を含む国内購入総額は90元です。現地通貨一単位が8元という仮のレートなら、それぞれ10.50と11.25です。両方とも計算は正しく、含む費用が異なります。前者を「商品代」、後者を「商品代＋国内送料」と記録します。

corrections.source: If another seller quotes 88 yuan for a pair including domestic delivery, compare 88 with 90 rather than 84. At this stage the second seller is two yuan cheaper under the stated conditions. You still need to compare what the two products include, seller terms and the final purchase page. Do not attach the entire price of a later international shipment to one of the listings unless it is the only item in that parcel and the assumptions match on both sides.
corrections.translation: 別の販売店の二枚組が国内送料込みで88元なら、商品代のみの84元でなく送料込みの90元と88元を比較します。この条件では後者の店が2元安くなります。二つの商品の構成、店舗の条件、最終購入画面も確認します。後日の国際配送で複数の商品を同梱する場合に、その運賃全額を一方の商品だけに足してはいけません。一点だけ送る場合でも比較の前提をそろえます。

corrections.source: Know what the currency selector can answer
corrections.translation: 通貨切替で分かることを確認する

corrections.source: The currency control on a catalogue helps you browse in familiar numbers. It is especially useful when comparing several shortlist entries in one sitting under the same rate assumptions. Record the displayed original price where possible, the selected currency and the time of your comparison. A different display tomorrow could reflect a rate update, a changed item option or a seller price revision. Keeping the original amount lets you test those explanations separately instead of assuming the item itself became more expensive.
corrections.translation: 通貨切替は馴染みの通貨で候補を見るための機能です。同じ時刻・レートの想定で複数候補を比べるときに便利です。可能なら元の表示価格、選択通貨、比較時刻を記録します。翌日の表示差は為替更新、選択仕様の違い、販売店の価格改定などが原因かもしれません。元の値があれば個別に確認できます。

corrections.source: At checkout read the currency code beside the final amount. A symbol alone can be ambiguous. Record which party is presenting the price and whether the payment screen offers another conversion. A catalogue is not the processor of the later transaction. The developer's iTaoBuy listing describes link-based purchases and international payment choices; the account's actual payment screen supplies the applicable details for your purchase. Use that screen for the specific amount you are about to authorize and save its transaction reference.
corrections.translation: 決済時は記号だけでなく金額の横の通貨コードを読みます。誰の提示価格か、決済画面でもう一度換算の選択があるかを記録します。一覧は後の決済を処理する事業者ではありません。iTaoBuyのアプリ説明はリンク購入と国際決済の概要を示し、自分の取引に適用される詳細はアカウントの決済画面に出ます。承認直前の金額と取引番号を保存します。

corrections.source: Test an apparent price difference with a controlled example
corrections.translation: 同じ条件で価格差の理由を調べる

corrections.source: Imagine that two screenshots show 12.00 and 12.80 in your preferred currency. You cannot conclude that the second has a worse exchange rate from those figures alone. First inspect the seller price on both. If the first includes 96 yuan of goods and the second includes the same goods plus eight yuan of domestic postage, the higher amount can result from scope even when both use an identical rate. Recalculate from the original components before comparing the conversions themselves.
corrections.translation: 決済画面のスクリーンショットに、選択した通貨でそれぞれ 12.00 と 13.00 が表示されているとします。後者の金額が高いことだけで、為替レートが不利だとは判断できません。まず元建ての明細を確認します。通貨１単位につき８元なら、96元の商品代は 12.00 です。２枚目に中国国内送料８元も含まれていれば、同じレートでも合計は 13.00 になります。為替レートを比べる前に、両方の金額に含まれる費目をそろえましょう。

corrections.source: Next hold the original subtotal constant. With a 96-yuan purchase converted to 12 units, the implied rate is eight yuan per unit. The same 96 yuan converted to 12.80 implies 7.5 yuan per unit, provided no additional amount is bundled into either figure. That proviso is important. An apparent implied rate can absorb a service or payment charge if the screen combines entries. Call it a comparison of effective totals until the checkout explicitly identifies how the amounts are calculated.
corrections.translation: 次は商品小計を96元に固定します。換算後が12単位なら一単位当たり8元、同じ96元が12.80単位なら一単位当たり7.5元です。どちらの金額にも別の費用が含まれていないことが前提です。サービス料や決済手数料を合算した画面で逆算すると、それらの費用まで見掛けのレートに含まれます。計算方法が明示されるまでは実際の支払総額の比較として扱いましょう。

corrections.source: Reconcile a settled payment without counting conversion twice
corrections.translation: 換算を二重に数えず確定した支払いを照合する

corrections.source: For a completed purchase, save the seller or agent receipt, payment confirmation and posted account amount. Use the identifiers to ensure they concern the same purchase. A pending authorization may later change or disappear; match a settled entry when reconciling final cost. Remove personal account details from screenshots you share with support and show only the currency, amount, relevant reference and date. A long statement containing unrelated transactions rarely helps someone answer a question about a single order.
corrections.translation: 購入後は販売店か代行業者の領収書、支払確認、口座の確定明細を保存し、各番号で同じ取引と確かめます。仮承認は後に変わったり消えたりするため、最終費用は確定分で照合します。相談用の画像では口座の個人情報を隠し、通貨、金額、該当番号、日付だけを示します。無関係な取引を含む長い明細は一点の質問には不要です。

corrections.source: Build a short sequence from the original item to the posted amount. Start with goods and domestic delivery in their original currency. Add only charges explicitly recorded. Note the payment currency and amount next. If the bank records a further conversion, put that in a separate column. Avoid applying your own model rate again to an amount already denominated in your account currency. That common mistake can make a completely ordinary purchase look dramatically different from the amount you actually paid.
corrections.translation: 商品代と中国国内送料を元の通貨で記し、明示された料金だけを加えます。次に決済通貨と額、銀行での追加換算があれば別欄に書きます。すでに口座通貨で計上された額に自分の仮レートをもう一度当てないようにしましょう。二重換算すると普通の取引でも実際の支払額と大きく違って見えます。

corrections.source: Decide whether a small difference should change the purchase
corrections.translation: わずかな差が購入判断に影響するか考える

corrections.source: After normalizing unit, scope, currency and time, ask what remains material to your decision. A tiny conversion difference may be less important than a seller option that includes both pieces you need, an identified size chart or clearer product evidence. If the remaining gap is large, return to the payment screen and look for the first stage at which the totals diverge. A focused question identifying a particular subtotal is much easier to resolve than a general complaint about conversion.
corrections.translation: 販売単位、含む費用、通貨、時刻を合わせた後、差額が選択を左右するか考えます。わずかな換算差より必須の二点がそろうことや明確なサイズ表・商品写真の方が重要かもしれません。大きな差が残れば、決済画面で初めて金額が分かれた段階を探します。漠然と換算がおかしいと言うより、特定の小計を示して尋ねる方が調べやすくなります。

corrections.source: Keep the final comparison reproducible. One good row says which listing and option you chose, how many units, the original subtotal, domestic delivery, checkout currency and amount, and which rate was merely illustrative. When international freight is quoted later, enter it as a new transaction for the actual parcel. This preserves the difference between comparing products before purchase and calculating the overall cost once packaging and transport are known. It also lets you reuse the same method when shopping in a different display currency.
corrections.translation: 出品、選んだ仕様、個数、元の小計、国内送料、決済通貨と金額、説明用に使った仮レートを一行にまとめます。後日国際送料が確定したら実際の荷物の別取引として記録します。買う前の商品比較と、梱包や配送が決まった後の総費用を分けられ、別の表示通貨でも同じ手順を使えます。

corrections.source: For a shared purchase, agree on the currency used to divide the bill and keep evidence of the actual amount charged. Dividing the cart's rounded display price may leave a small discrepancy once the transaction posts. A fair record shows the original checkout amount, the settled total and the number of items allocated to each person. Label any later international freight separately so the group can see what changed.
corrections.translation: 共同購入では割り勘の通貨を決め、実際の請求額を保存します。丸めたカート表示を先に割ると確定額に少し差が出る場合があります。元の決済表示、確定額、各人の割当数量を示し、後の国際送料は別に記して何が変わったか分かるようにします。

corrections.source: iTaoBuy tracking: keep seller delivery, warehouse intake and international dispatch separate
corrections.translation: iTaoBuyの追跡方法：販売店の配送・倉庫入荷・国際発送を区別する

corrections.source: A “delivered” scan can mean that a seller's box reached a warehouse in China while your international parcel has yet to be created. Follow the references through each stage instead of asking one tracking number to describe the whole journey.
corrections.translation: 「配達済み」が販売店の箱の中国倉庫到着を示し、国際配送の荷物はまだ作られていないことがあります。全行程を一つの番号で説明しようとせず、段階ごとの番号をたどります。

corrections.source: Start by naming both ends of the journey
corrections.translation: 配送の出発地と到着地を確認する

corrections.source: Identify the sender and intended recipient for the tracking event you are reading. The seller-to-warehouse journey has the seller at one end and the receiving warehouse at the other. The warehouse-to-you journey begins later, once an outbound parcel exists. The same purchase can appear in both journeys under different references. A domestic delivery event tells you something about the movement of the seller's package. It does not establish the delivery date of a future international parcel.
corrections.translation: 見ている追跡履歴の差出人と宛先を特定します。国内区間は販売店から受入倉庫、国際区間は後で出荷する荷物を作成してから倉庫から受取人までです。同じ購入が異なる番号で両区間に現れます。国内の配達履歴が示すのは販売店の荷物の移動で、その後の国際配送の配達日までは分かりません。

corrections.source: Consider two shirts from different sellers. One seller dispatches on Monday and the domestic carrier records delivery to a warehouse on Wednesday. The other seller has not dispatched. You intend to send both shirts together internationally. The Wednesday event cannot possibly confirm delivery of the combined parcel, because at that point the second shirt has not reached the warehouse. Drawing the endpoints of the current shipment is often enough to explain what initially looks like a contradictory or alarming tracking update.
corrections.translation: 別々の店でシャツを一枚ずつ買い、一方は月曜発送、水曜倉庫配達済み、他方は未発送とします。二枚を同梱するなら、水曜の履歴が完成した国際荷物の配達を示すことはありません。二枚目はまだ倉庫にもないからです。今の荷物がどこからどこへ行くかを書けば、一見矛盾した追跡表示も理解できます。

corrections.source: Keep the purchase line and the domestic package distinct
corrections.translation: 購入した明細と中国国内の荷物を区別する

corrections.source: Save the purchase reference, seller listing, selected options and quantity for each order. Then attach any domestic carrier reference supplied for that purchase. A seller can split a purchase across more than one package, or put several pieces in one. Consequently a one-to-one table between item and tracking number may break down. Allow several item references to share a domestic number and allow a single purchase to have more than one domestic number where the seller's records support it.
corrections.translation: 各注文の購入番号、販売ページ、仕様、数量を保存し、販売店が示した中国国内追跡番号を結び付けます。一つの購入を分けて送る店も、複数点を一箱に入れる店もあります。商品一点と追跡番号一個が必ず対応する表にはせず、複数商品が同じ番号、一注文が複数番号になる関係も記録できるようにします。

corrections.source: For an order containing a shirt and matching trousers, record which pieces the seller says were placed in each box. If the seller has supplied two numbers but no allocation, mark the allocation unknown. Do not infer that the first number belongs to the shirt because the shirt was listed first. When the warehouse records the incoming contents, use that evidence to complete the mapping. This small distinction prevents a genuinely outstanding box from being misreported as a missing component in a box that never contained it.
corrections.translation: シャツとそろいのパンツなら、販売店が各箱に何を入れたと言ったかを記します。番号二つだけで割り振りがなければ未確認です。先に表示された番号が最初の商品に対応すると推測せず、入荷後の現物記録で埋めます。別の箱がまだ輸送中なのに、最初から入っていない箱の欠品だと誤って申告するのを防げます。

corrections.source: Read warehouse intake as its own event
corrections.translation: 倉庫の入荷処理は別の出来事として確認する

corrections.source: A carrier scan describes a logistics event. Warehouse intake identifies goods within the receiving system. A delivery scan and an item appearing in warehouse inventory therefore supply different pieces of evidence. If one appears without the other, check the domestic number, warehouse destination and purchase reference. Record the time of the last confirmed event using the time zone shown. Avoid extrapolating a guaranteed intake interval from another buyer's order or from an unrelated carrier's display.
corrections.translation: 配送会社のスキャンは物流上の出来事、倉庫の入荷処理は受領システム内での商品特定です。配達済み表示と在庫画面への掲載は別々の証拠です。片方だけなら国内番号、倉庫宛先、購入番号を照合し、最後に確認できた時刻を表示のタイムゾーンとともに記します。他の購入者や別会社の表示から一定時間内の入荷を保証と考えないようにします。

corrections.source: The developer describes iTaoBuy as purchasing and shipping on request and supplying QC photos after the seller sends goods to the warehouse. For an individual purchase, look for the warehouse entry or photographs connected to your order. A product photo attached to the right entry can help confirm which unit arrived. A generic seller photograph or historical QC reference cannot do that job. If you need support, send the domestic reference, purchase identifier and which received item is missing from the account record.
corrections.translation: iTaoBuyの開発元は、依頼による買い付け・発送と、販売店から倉庫に届いた後の検品写真を説明しています。個別注文では自分の注文に付く入荷記録や写真を探します。その商品を写した入荷写真なら何が届いたかを確認できますが、販売店の一般画像や過去の検品例では代用できません。問い合わせには国内番号、購入番号、アカウントに載っていない品を示します。

corrections.source: Connect warehouse entries to the outbound parcel
corrections.translation: 倉庫明細と国際配送の荷物を結び付ける

corrections.source: When you choose the items to send internationally, save a list of their warehouse entries beside the new parcel reference. Several seller packages can contribute to one outbound parcel; one warehouse entry may also be left behind for another shipment. Identify what is actually included rather than treating everything in storage as dispatched. This becomes particularly important when one item is under inspection or waiting for an exchange and the remainder are ready to travel.
corrections.translation: 国際発送する品を選んだら、新しい荷物番号と対応する入荷明細を保存します。複数の販売店の箱を一つにまとめる場合や、入庫済みの一点を次回まで残す場合もあります。保管品全部が出庫とみなさず、現に選んだ物を特定します。検品・交換待ちの一点を残して他を先に送るときは特に重要です。

corrections.source: For the two shirts, suppose the first shirt is accepted and the second is awaiting a size check. If you decide to ship only the first, record that choice explicitly. The international tracking page for the first parcel cannot tell you when the second shirt will leave. Conversely, if you decide to wait and consolidate, there may be no outbound tracking number yet. In both cases the explanation comes from the parcel contents and submission decision, not from the domestic carrier's earlier delivery scan.
corrections.translation: シャツ一枚目は承認済み、二枚目はサイズ確認中で、一枚目だけ送るならその判断を記します。一個目の国際追跡では二枚目の発送時期は分かりません。反対に二枚を待って同梱するなら、国際番号自体がまだないこともあります。理由はどの品をいつ発送申請したかにあり、先の国内配達履歴には出ません。

corrections.source: Distinguish a label from movement and movement from delivery
corrections.translation: 送り状発行・輸送・配達完了を区別する

corrections.source: Read the wording of each outbound event carefully. A reference or label can exist before the carrier has recorded a physical handoff. A transit event can show movement through part of the route without establishing a delivery appointment. A local-carrier number, if one is provided, may describe a later stage of the same international parcel. Record the carrier and reference together rather than overwriting the original outbound number when a second identifier appears.
corrections.translation: 国際配送の各履歴の文言を読みます。番号や荷札は運送会社の現物受領より先にでき、輸送中の履歴は一部区間の移動で配達予約を意味しません。後に現地番号が付くなら、同じ国際荷物の別区間かもしれません。二つ目が出ても最初の出庫番号を上書きせず、運送会社名と番号を組で残します。

corrections.source: If the same event appears on two tracking pages with slightly different labels, compare the event time, location and parcel reference. A translation can turn an operational status into an overly definite-sounding statement. When the scope remains uncertain, quote the actual event text in your support message and ask what stage it represents. Resist filling gaps with a guessed customs decision, exact flight or delivery date. An absence of new public scans gives much less information than a confirmed exception from the responsible carrier.
corrections.translation: 二つの追跡ページで似た出来事の訳が違えば、時刻、場所、荷物番号を比べます。業務上の表示が翻訳で断定的に見えることがあります。不明なら原文を引用して、どの段階か尋ねます。通関結果、便名、到着日を推測で補わないようにしましょう。公表スキャンが増えないことと、担当運送会社が異常を確認したことは別です。

corrections.source: Investigate one missing link at a time
corrections.translation: 記録のつながりが途切れた箇所を一つずつ調べる

corrections.source: Start with the last event you can independently associate with the correct shipment. If there is no domestic number and the seller order still shows no dispatch, the inquiry belongs with purchase status. If a domestic number shows warehouse delivery but no purchase line is matched, the question concerns intake. If the warehouse entry is present but no parcel includes it, review parcel submission. If a submitted international parcel has a carrier reference but an unresolved exception, use the outbound record and carrier information.
corrections.translation: 正しい荷物に対応すると確かめられる最後の出来事から調べます。販売店が未発送で国内番号がなければ買い付け状況、倉庫へ配達済みで注文と結び付かなければ入荷処理、入荷済みで荷物に含まれなければ出庫申請を確認します。国際荷物を提出して運送会社番号があるのに異常が残る場合は出庫記録と担当会社を使います。

corrections.source: Write a message that identifies the gap. For example: “Seller package A is marked delivered to the warehouse on the domestic carrier page. The account shows the matching shirt order but I cannot find its warehouse entry. Can you check whether it has been matched?” This is more actionable than “Where is my parcel?” because the reader knows which journey and which handoff need attention. Include only the personal or shipment information needed through the platform's private support channel.
corrections.translation: 例えば「荷物Aは中国国内の追跡で倉庫に配達済みです。該当のシャツ注文はありますが入荷明細が見当たりません。紐付け済みか確認できますか」と依頼します。単に「荷物はどこですか」より、どの区間のどの受け渡しか分かります。注文の非公開窓口で必要な個人情報と発送情報だけを示します。

corrections.source: Verify delivery against physical contents
corrections.translation: 配達結果と実際の中身を照合する

corrections.source: When the outbound parcel arrives, retain the label and compare its reference with your saved parcel record. Check the contents against the warehouse entries that were selected for this shipment, including any item intentionally left out. If something is missing, distinguish a piece absent from an included set from a whole item that was never selected. Keep relevant packaging and photographs while checking the platform's current reporting procedure. An item's domestic delivery record cannot settle a discrepancy in the outbound contents by itself.
corrections.translation: 国際荷物が届いたら荷札を残し、番号を出庫記録と突き合わせます。意図的に外した品も考慮し、選択した入荷明細と中身を比較します。発送対象のセットから一部が足りないことと、最初から発送対象にしなかったことは別です。現行の申告方法を確認しながら包装と写真を保管します。販売店からの国内配達の記録だけでは国際荷物の不足は解決できません。

corrections.source: Close the tracking record with a simple chain of references linking seller purchase, domestic package, warehouse entry, outbound parcel and delivery. Leave unresolved links clearly marked. This gives you a reusable way to understand combined and split orders without assuming that every stage uses the same number. More importantly, it lets you ask the right party a precise question about the last confirmed handoff and the next event you actually need to verify.
corrections.translation: 販売店への注文、国内荷物、入荷明細、国際荷物、最終配達に対応する番号をつないで完了記録にします。不明なつながりは未確認とします。合梱や分割で同じ番号が通して使われない場合も、最後に確認した引き渡しと次に必要な確認を示し、適切な相手に質問できます。

corrections.source:
For a delivery involving a collection point, keep the notification naming that point alongside the carrier history. A scan indicating arrival at a pickup location creates a different practical task from a scan confirming collection. Check the address and collection instructions through the carrier's own channel before travelling. If a person other than the intended recipient collected the parcel, record the evidence the carrier provides and contact the relevant support channel with the destination tracking number and observed discrepancy.
Save the final collection receipt alongside the corresponding tracking record.
corrections.translation: 受取拠点を使う場合は、拠点名の通知と追跡履歴を保存します。拠点に到着した表示と受取済みは違います。出かける前に運送会社の公式窓口で住所と手順を確かめます。予定した人以外が受け取った場合は、提供された証拠を記録し、現地番号と相違を窓口へ伝えます。最終的な受取控えも該当の追跡記録と一緒に残します。

corrections.source: How to find the original iTaoBuy listing from a product photo
corrections.translation: 商品写真からiTaoBuyで元の販売ページを探す方法

corrections.source: An image match can bring a promising listing to the top while hiding a different seller, option or size range. Use image search to build a shortlist, then identify which result contains enough evidence for the purchase you have in mind.
corrections.translation: 画像検索の上位には、写真は似ていても販売店、仕様、サイズ展開が異なる商品が出ます。候補を絞った後、希望する購入内容を裏付ける情報があるかを確かめます。

corrections.source: Decide what “the same item” means in this search
corrections.translation: 今回の検索で「同じ商品」の条件を決める

corrections.source: You see a photograph of a cream canvas bag with a dark base and want to find the listing behind it. There are at least three worthwhile outcomes. You might recover the exact link the photographer used. You might find a seller offering an apparently identical model under another listing. Or you might find a similar bag that meets your needs. Decide which outcome matters before spending time on the search. If the original poster provided a marketplace URL, start with it. A visual lookup is most useful when that direct route is missing.
corrections.translation: 濃い色の底を持つクリーム色の帆布バッグの写真を見たとします。撮影者が使った元リンク、別出品の同じような型、自分の用途を満たす似たバッグの三つでは目標が違います。どこまでの一致が必要か最初に決めます。元の投稿に販売リンクがあればそこから始め、直接の手掛かりがないときに画像検索を使います。

corrections.source: Describe two or three details in words while the original picture is in front of you. For this example, there might be a curved seam at the base, a front pocket with a diagonal opening and a strap attached to a metal ring. These details let you compare candidates after a new image or similar product name has drawn your attention. If your only description is “cream tote bag,” almost any plausible result can feel like a match. A short list of visible details gives you a more demanding test.
corrections.translation: 元画像を見ながら、底のカーブした縫い目、斜め口の前ポケット、金属リングに付いたストラップなど二、三の特徴を言葉にします。「クリーム色のトート」だけでは候補の多くが一致して見えます。新しい写真や似た名前に気を取られても、元の可視の特徴を一つずつ比較できます。

corrections.source: Prepare a crop for shape and a crop for construction
corrections.translation: 外形と構造の特徴が分かる二種類の画像を用意する

corrections.source: Begin with the outline. Remove surrounding people, captions, account names, collages and objects occupying more of the frame than the product. Leave the complete bag in view, including its handles and base. A tight crop of a graphic or zipper may suppress exactly the silhouette that distinguishes the product. Use the camera entry on this site's search interface and submit the crop. Keep the original untouched so that you can return to omitted details later.
corrections.translation: 最初は輪郭を重視し、周囲の人物、文字、アカウント名、コラージュ、商品より目立つ背景物を除きます。持ち手と底を含めバッグ全体を残します。柄やファスナーだけに寄ると特徴的な形が消えます。サイトの検索欄のカメラ入口から切り抜きを送り、後で除いた部分も確認できるよう元画像は変更せず保存します。

corrections.source: For a second query, crop around a structural feature that the first picture does not emphasize. A pocket plus its surrounding seam gives more context than a close-up of a common metal buckle. Change just this part of the search first. When you change the crop, lighting, orientation and background in a single edit, you cannot tell which change altered the matches. Compare the shortlists and mark candidates appearing in both. Frequency across searches can justify opening a result, but it does not establish where the original photograph was taken.
corrections.translation: 次の検索は最初の画像で目立たなかった構造を切り抜きます。よくある留め具だけよりポケットと周囲の縫い目が有力です。まず切り抜く部分だけを変えます。照明、向き、背景も同時に変えると結果の差の理由が分かりません。両方に出た候補は開く手掛かりにできますが、元写真の出所を示すわけではありません。

corrections.source: Separate seller catalogues from the photograph trail
corrections.translation: 販売ページの特定と写真の出所の確認を分ける

corrections.source: Open promising product pages and find the source marketplace link if it is available. Record the marketplace and the listing identifier, together with the shop name you see on the seller page. An agent-facing URL can provide another view of the same seller listing. A different seller can also display the same image under an entirely different item number. Make a separate record whenever marketplace or listing identity changes, even if the gallery looks familiar.
corrections.translation: 有望な商品ページを開き、元の販売リンクがあれば、販売サイト、商品番号、表示された店名を控えます。同じ販売ページが代行用URLで別表示になることも、別の店が同じ写真を違う番号で使うこともあります。画像が似ていてもサイトや商品番号が違えば別の記録にします。

corrections.source: Imagine results A and B have identical studio photos, while C has a less polished picture showing the diagonal pocket and ring attachment. A and B could be showing a photograph shared through a supply chain. C might help answer what the item looks like under different conditions, but a rougher picture does not prove that C supplied the original. Look for a link or attribution from the original post, a matching item number, an order reference you control or another reliable connection. Until then, describe them as visual candidates.
corrections.translation: 候補AとBが同じスタジオ写真、Cが斜めポケットとリングを写した素朴な写真なら、A・Bは仕入れ経路で共有された画像かもしれません。Cは別条件での外観を知る参考でも、元の撮影者とは断定できません。元投稿のリンクや明示された出所、商品番号、自分の注文履歴など信頼できるつながりが見つかるまでは、外観が似た候補として扱います。

corrections.source: Test the variant rather than accepting the hero photograph
corrections.translation: 代表写真だけでなく選択した仕様を確かめる

corrections.source: On each shortlisted listing, open the option selector and choose the colour shown in the original. Observe which elements change. The lead image may change to a swatch, the displayed price may change, or the same photograph may remain for the whole listing. If more than one option could match, save the original option text and compare any accompanying description. Two bags called ivory in translation might differ by size, strap style or whether the darker base is included.
corrections.translation: 候補ごとに元写真の色を選び、先頭画像、色見本、価格が変わるか、それとも同じ写真のままかを観察します。一致しそうな仕様が複数あれば原文と付属説明を保存します。どちらも「アイボリー」と訳されても、大きさ、ストラップ、濃い底の有無が違う場合があります。

corrections.source: For the cream bag, a result that shows the correct pocket but offers only an all-cream base is a partial match. A result with three base colours but no image attached to the chosen option leaves an unresolved question. In either case, identify the single detail that separates the candidates. Asking whether the charcoal-bottom version is available with the diagonal pocket is easier to answer than sending a collage and asking a seller, “Is it the same?” A catalogue hit becomes useful when it narrows the question.
corrections.translation: クリーム色バッグでポケットは合うが底までクリーム色なら部分一致です。底色が三種あって選択画像がなければ未確認です。候補を分ける一点を特定し、「斜めポケットで底がチャコールの仕様はありますか」のように聞きます。画像をまとめて「同じですか」と頼むより、答えの出る質問になります。

corrections.source: Use measurements to reject plausible lookalikes
corrections.translation: 寸法を使って見た目が似た別商品を除く

corrections.source: Pictures rarely reveal scale cleanly. A small handbag and a larger tote can share handle proportions, stitching and studio styling. Look for dimensions tied to the chosen option, including the unit and the points being measured. A width measured at the open top of a tapered bag differs from its base width. If you need the bag to hold a particular object, measure that object first and allow for the opening and closure rather than relying on the external width alone.
corrections.translation: 小さいハンドバッグと大きいトートで、持ち手の比率、縫い目、撮影方法が同じなら写真だけでは大きさは読めません。選択仕様の寸法、単位、採寸位置を確認します。先細りのバッグでは開口幅と底幅が違います。特定の物を入れるなら先にその物を測り、外幅だけでなく開口部や留め具の分も考慮します。

corrections.source: Consider a hypothetical notebook 29 centimetres long. A seller's stated exterior width of 30 centimetres does not tell you whether the notebook will pass through a zipped opening shorter than the body. A straight-on picture that makes the notebook appear small also gives no reliable clearance measurement. Ask about the opening or compare an object of known dimensions in an image where perspective is controlled. This second check can eliminate a mistaken size even when the visual model is otherwise correct.
corrections.translation: 長さ29センチの紙のノートを入れたいとします。バッグの外幅が30センチでも、ファスナーの開口部が本体より短ければ通るかは分かりません。正面写真でノートが小さく見えても余裕を正確には測れません。開口部の実寸を尋ねるか、遠近によるずれが小さい写真で既知の寸法の物と比べます。外観は同じモデルに見えても、サイズの取り違えを防げます。

corrections.source: Carry the evidence into the iTaoBuy order
corrections.translation: 確認した情報をiTaoBuyの注文に引き継ぐ

corrections.source: The developer's iTaoBuy app description explains that buyers can paste marketplace links and use warehouse photographs to review items. Once you reach a candidate you want to order, paste the seller link into the agent and check that the imported page shows the intended option. Compare the price after selection, the quantity, the source listing and any seller-specific notes. If the agent page resets the selection, apply it again and record the final state before approving the purchase.
corrections.translation: iTaoBuyのアプリ説明では販売リンクを貼って買い付けし、倉庫写真で商品を確認できます。候補を決めたら販売リンクを取り込み、希望仕様が出たか確認します。選択後の価格、数量、元の出品、販売店固有の注意を見比べます。選択が戻っていれば再選択し、承認前の最終状態を記録します。

corrections.source: Keep the picture trail compact. Save the original reference; one screenshot of the chosen seller listing and its selected option; and your short list of unresolved checks. For our bag that list might be “dark base, diagonal pocket, opening wide enough for notebook.” When the warehouse entry becomes available, evaluate that unit against the list. The photograph that launched the search remains a reference image. The warehouse photographs attached to the actual purchase now carry more weight for deciding whether to ship the unit you received.
corrections.translation: 画像の記録は簡潔にまとめます。元の参考画像、選択した販売店と仕様が一緒に見える画面、残る確認事項を保存します。例のバッグなら「底が濃色、斜めポケット、紙のノートが通る開口部」です。入荷後はその一覧と対象商品の写真を照合します。検索に使った元画像は参考であり、届いた商品を発送するかの判断には、この購入の倉庫明細に付いた現物写真がより役立ちます。

corrections.source: Know when the exact original remains unknown
corrections.translation: 元の出品を特定できない場合を見極める

corrections.source: Sometimes several shops show the same photographs and none supplies an identifier connecting it to the original post. Write down what you can establish: same visible design, similar measurements, or matching option description. Leave seller identity unknown if you cannot connect the records. This makes the buying decision more honest and more useful. You can still compare price and terms between candidates without turning a visual resemblance into an unsupported claim about origin.
corrections.translation: 同じ写真を複数の店が使い、元投稿につながる番号が得られない場合があります。一致する外観、近い実寸、同じ仕様説明など確かめた範囲を残し、つながりがなければ元の販売店は不明とします。出所の証明がなくても、候補の価格と条件は個別に比較できます。

corrections.source: If the distinctive feature is decisive and no listing shows it clearly, the efficient next step is one specific request for evidence, not a longer list of increasingly similar pictures. If the feature is optional and several alternatives meet your needs, compare them on their own terms. Close your search with the seller link, selected option and the reason for choosing it. Those three things will outlast a numbered position in search results and will still make sense when you review the warehouse photographs days later.
corrections.translation: 決め手の特徴がどの候補でも不鮮明なら、似た写真をさらに集めるより、一点だけ証拠を依頼します。必須でなく他の品も用途に足りるなら、それぞれの条件で比較します。選んだ店のリンク、仕様、選んだ理由を残せば、検索順位が変わった後や数日後に倉庫写真を見るときも判断をたどれます。

corrections.source: A cropped image can hide the one feature that distinguishes two otherwise identical models. If the original photo is available, inspect the uncropped edges for a clasp, pocket opening or printed code. Record how that feature appears on each candidate listing before committing to one.
corrections.translation: 切り抜くと、よく似た型を分ける留め金、ポケット口、印刷コードが消えることがあります。元画像の端まで確認し、各候補でその特徴がどう見えるかを記録してから選びます。

corrections.source: Organizing iTaoBuy QC photos when several similar items arrive together
corrections.translation: よく似た商品が同時に届いたときのiTaoBuy検品写真の整理方法

corrections.source: Three nearly identical shirts can produce a gallery full of convincing pictures without proving which size belongs to which order. Build an item-by-item record that ties each photograph to the decision it actually supports.
corrections.translation: よく似たシャツ三着の写真がたくさんあっても、どの注文がどのサイズか分かるとは限りません。一点ずつ、写真とその写真で判断できることを結び付けます。

corrections.source: Use the warehouse entry as the organizing unit
corrections.translation: 倉庫の入荷明細ごとに整理する

corrections.source: Start with the order lines and warehouse entries visible in your account. Give each received unit or clearly identified group a separate row. Record the purchase reference, seller option, expected quantity and warehouse reference. If a single order includes several identical units, label their individual identities as unknown unless the warehouse records actually distinguish them. A neat filing system is useful only if it preserves the limits of what you know. Numbering a photograph “unit three” cannot make it evidence about a third unit.
corrections.translation: 購入明細と倉庫明細から、個別に識別できた現品またはグループに一行を使い、購入番号、仕様、予定数量、入庫番号を記します。同じ品が複数あり倉庫で区別されていなければ個別の識別は未確認です。整理のために「三点目」と名付けても三点目の証拠が生まれるわけではありません。

corrections.source: Imagine that you ordered two blue shirts in medium and a blue shirt in large. A front view of a blue shirt confirms something about colour and design but little about size or count. Make three expected-unit rows, then attach photographs only where the account record supports the connection. If the warehouse supplies one shared gallery for a group, keep it at group level until you can identify the pieces. This prevents a single attractive photograph from being counted as a separate check for all three clothes.
corrections.translation: 青シャツM二枚・L一枚なら、青い正面写真一枚で色やデザインは見えてもサイズと数量は不明です。予定の三行を作り、対応が確認できた写真だけを付けます。共通ギャラリーなら個別に特定できるまでグループに紐付けます。同じ一枚を三着それぞれの検品に数えません。

corrections.source: Keep original and annotated pictures apart
corrections.translation: 元画像と書き込みを加えた画像を分ける

corrections.source: Save or reference the original photograph with its warehouse entry. When you crop or draw an arrow, retain the original and label the copy by purpose, such as “medium tag enlarged” or “stitch near right cuff.” Cropping can be excellent for showing a small detail, yet it can remove the surroundings that associate the detail with the actual garment. Put a full-unit overview beside the close-up. If both images come from a sequence, keep their original order or note their source.
corrections.translation: 元画像を入庫番号と保存し、切り抜きや矢印は「Mタグ拡大」「右袖口の縫い目」など用途を書いたコピーに加えます。接写だけではどの服かを示す周囲が消えるため、全体写真と並べます。一連の画像なら元の順か出所を残します。

corrections.source: Avoid depending entirely on a phone's date sorting. Images can be downloaded on a different day from when the warehouse took them, or several orders can be downloaded together. Sorting by the download date might interleave an old reference photograph with new pictures. Include the purchase or warehouse reference in your folder or note. For sensitive account identifiers, keep the record private. If you share a picture publicly for a style opinion, remove unrelated order labels and personal details first.
corrections.translation: スマートフォンの日付順だけに頼らないようにします。倉庫の撮影日と保存日が違い、複数注文を一度に保存すると古い参考画像が混ざることもあります。フォルダーに購入・入庫番号を付け、機密性のある番号は非公開で扱います。公開の場でスタイルを尋ねるコピーからは無関係な荷札や個人情報を除きます。

corrections.source: Record which property each view can support
corrections.translation: 各写真で確認できる特徴を記録する

corrections.source: Write a short label for the question answered by each image. A front overview might establish the panel design. A complete size-tag photo may establish the attached label. A tape-measure image might establish width if both endpoints and units are shown. A seller studio photograph can be a comparison reference but cannot confirm the condition of your specific unit. Using these distinctions prevents a large photo count from creating false confidence about properties that no photograph actually addresses.
corrections.translation: 各写真が答える質問を書き添えます。正面の全体は切り替えのデザイン、タグ全体はその表記、メジャー写真は両端と単位が見えれば幅を示せます。販売店の宣材は比較用で、自分の現品の状態を示しません。写真の枚数が多くても写っていない特徴まで確認したつもりにならないようにします。

corrections.source: For the three shirts, check visible colour and pattern from the overviews, then inspect size evidence individually. A picture labelled medium and another labelled large can show two label values without proving there are two medium shirts. A third overview showing all three units together can help establish quantity. If labels still cannot be linked to distinct garments, record the uncertainty. The right response may be a single grouped photograph with the relevant labels visible, subject to what the warehouse can provide.
corrections.translation: 三着の色柄は全体で、サイズは各現品で確認します。Mタグ一枚とLタグ一枚では二種類の表示は分かってもMが二着とはいえません。三着を並べた写真なら数量を確かめやすくなります。タグと個体の対応が依然不明なら書き残し、可能なら各タグが読める集合写真を一枚依頼します。

corrections.source: Use an expected-versus-observed table
corrections.translation: 注文内容と確認結果を対照表にする

corrections.source: Each row can contain expected item, observed evidence, unresolved question and next action. Keep the observation narrow. For example, “medium label visible on warehouse entry A” is stronger and more precise than “correct size and perfect fit.” Fit requires additional measurements or a physical try-on. Similarly, “front print appears centred in this image” is a more defensible statement than a broad quality verdict. The difference matters when another person later relies on the notes to approve international shipment.
corrections.translation: 各行に予定品、観察結果、未確認事項、次の行動を記します。「入庫AでMタグを確認」は「サイズは合い着心地も完璧」より根拠に合います。着心地にはさらに実測や試着が必要です。「この写真で正面プリントは中央に見える」も全面的な品質評価とは区別します。記録を別の人が出庫判断に使うときに差が出ます。

corrections.source: Consider a case where medium shirt A matches the design, medium shirt B has no readable label and large shirt C has a clear label but the cuff is folded out of view. Two distinct evidence requests emerge. If size is crucial for B, ask for its attached label. If a cuff issue is suspected for C, ask to see that cuff unfolded. Do not ask for three new full galleries indiscriminately. Specific requests use the existing evidence and tell the warehouse exactly what remains unresolved.
corrections.translation: MのAはデザイン確認済み、MのBはタグが読めず、LのCはタグが読めても袖口が折れて見えないとします。Bのサイズが重要なら付いたタグを、Cの袖口に懸念があれば広げた状態を依頼します。三着とも写真一式を撮り直すのではなく未確認箇所を明確にします。

corrections.source: Handle repeated photographs and near-duplicates
corrections.translation: 同じ写真や酷似した写真を区別する

corrections.source: A cropped copy and its full original represent one observation of the same scene. A gallery can also contain several angles of a single unit. Do not count those as separate pieces merely because filenames or image URLs differ. Conversely, two similar shirts photographed against the same table can produce almost identical overviews even when the units really are distinct. Resolve identity with the warehouse entry, label and physical arrangement, rather than guessing from image similarity alone.
corrections.translation: 切り抜きと元画像は同じ場面の観察です。同じ服の複数角度も別の個数に数えません。一方、同じ机で撮った似たシャツ二点は別の服でもほぼ同じ全体写真になります。ファイル名・URLや見た目だけで判断せず、入庫番号、タグ、現物の配置で個体を確かめます。

corrections.source: If you suspect a photograph belongs to the wrong entry, describe the conflict rather than accusing the warehouse of reusing an image. For example, one entry is for a blue medium but the visible label reads large, while the next entry is for a blue large. Ask whether the label picture was attached to the intended unit. Keep the earlier images while the check proceeds. If a corrected image arrives, record what it replaces so that the superseded picture does not accidentally guide a later decision.
corrections.translation: 写真の添付先が違うと思ったら、使い回しと断定せず食い違いを説明します。例えば青Mの明細のタグがLで、次の明細は青Lなら、タグ写真の紐付けを確かめます。照会中は以前の画像を保管し、訂正版が届けばどの画像を差し替えるか記して、古い方で出庫を判断しないようにします。

corrections.source: Distinguish a previous buyer's QC from your own
corrections.translation: 過去の購入者の検品写真と自分の写真を区別する

corrections.source: A historical QC finder or catalogue gallery can be useful when researching a seller before purchase. Label such evidence as a reference and store it separately from the actual warehouse record. Match marketplace listing, option and date where possible. A previous buyer may have selected a different size, colour or production version. Even a highly relevant historical image cannot establish that your received garment has the same label or lacks the same visible defect.
corrections.translation: 過去の検品検索や一覧写真は購入前の販売店調査に使えますが、参考と付けて自分の入荷記録とは別に保管します。可能ならサイト、出品、仕様、日付を合わせます。以前の人はサイズ・色・製造版が違うことがあり、よく似た写真でも自分の服のタグや欠陥の有無は確定しません。

corrections.source: The iTaoBuy developer describes supplying warehouse QC photos for buyers to review. When your own images appear, use the new order-linked evidence for the current unit and keep the historical image only for the specific comparison it supports. If historical photos show a stitched emblem and your received unit appears printed, compare clear close-ups tied to the exact variant before deciding the seller changed the product. It is also possible that the public reference came from a different option within the same listing.
corrections.translation: iTaoBuyの開発元は購入者向けの倉庫検品写真を案内しています。自分の写真が出たら新しい注文紐付け画像で現物を判断し、古いものは該当する比較だけに使います。過去の刺しゅうが今はプリントに見えても、商品変更と判断する前に正確な仕様ごとの接写を比較します。同一出品の別仕様だった可能性もあります。

corrections.source: Finish with a per-item release decision
corrections.translation: 商品ごとに出庫するかを決める

corrections.source: Before sending the group internationally, mark each expected item separately as ready, awaiting evidence or requiring support. A correct blue large should not automatically clear two blue mediums, and one disputed item should not silently block another if you intended separate shipments. Compare the release list with the actual parcel contents. If items are repacked or warehouse entries consolidated, retain the mapping from old identifiers to the outbound parcel record so that the photographs remain meaningful after dispatch.
corrections.translation: 国際発送前に各品を「出庫可」「証拠待ち」「相談が必要」に分け、実際の梱包内容と出庫一覧を比べます。青L一着の確認で青M二着まで承認せず、別送の予定なら一点の問題で他の出庫も暗黙に止めません。再梱包・統合後も旧入庫番号と出荷番号の対応を保ち、写真の対象を追えるようにします。

corrections.source: Keep the final archive small enough to use. For each item, retain its order confirmation, one identifying overview, the decisive detail and your conclusion. If something remains uncertain, state whether you accepted that uncertainty or requested another check. Later, when the package arrives, compare each piece against those records. You can then distinguish a pre-existing concern from an issue first observed after delivery and explain the difference without sifting through dozens of anonymous images of similar blue shirts.
corrections.translation: 一点につき注文確認、識別できる全体写真、決め手の細部、結論を残します。不明点は許容したか追加確認を求めたかも記します。配達後に一点ずつこの記録と比べれば、以前からの懸念と受領時に初めて気づいたことを、似た青シャツの無名画像を何十枚も探さず説明できます。

corrections.source: Give the recipient a simple way to distinguish the final pieces. If the buyer chose two nearly identical shirts for different people, keep a private note mapping each warehouse reference to its intended recipient and verified size. A carrier label on the international carton will identify neither individual shirt. After delivery, the recipient can consult the assignment note and the same label photographs used at inspection without reopening the original conversation with the seller.
corrections.translation: よく似た二着を別々の人用に買ったら、各倉庫番号と確認済みサイズ、受取人の対応を非公開メモにします。国際箱の荷札は個々のシャツを示しません。到着後、そのメモと検品時のタグ写真を見れば、販売店とのやり取りを開き直さずに配れます。

corrections.source: How to prepare an iTaoBuy parcel support request
corrections.translation: iTaoBuyの荷物について問い合わせるときの記録と証拠のそろえ方

corrections.source: Build a clear support request for an incomplete, delayed or damaged parcel using the correct order, shipment and evidence.
corrections.translation: 不着・遅延・破損や中身不足を相談するときは、対象の注文と発送番号を特定し、その問題に対応する証拠をそろえます。

corrections.source: iTaoBuy
corrections.translation: iTaoBuy

corrections.source: Start with the decision you need
corrections.translation: どの判断を求めているかを先に示す

corrections.source: A good support request tells the reader what happened, which transaction it affects and what answer would let you move forward. Start with one sentence you could read aloud. For example, “My international parcel arrived with two of the three storage pouches on the dispatch list. Can you confirm which package contained the green pouch?” This gives the agent an identifiable item and a question that they can check against the packing record.
corrections.translation: 何が起きたか、該当取引、次に進むのに必要な回答を一文で示します。例えば「国際荷物の出庫明細の収納ポーチ三点中二点が届きました。緑のポーチを入れた箱を確認できますか」なら、担当者は品を特定し梱包記録を調べられます。

corrections.source: Separate what you observed from any theory about the cause. You can count the two pouches on your desk. You may be able to identify an outer cut in the shipping bag. Unless someone documented the entire packing and delivery journey, you generally cannot know where a third pouch went missing. Describing the observed count and condition gives staff several ways to investigate.
